---

"Programming" has its roots in Latin "programma", meaning "public notice" (we
can still find this original meaning in the work "proclamation"), which derives
itself from the Greek "programma", meaning "a written public notice"
[^etymology]. Its stems are _pro-_ "forward" and _graphein_ "to write".

This does however not really capture what we consider as "programming" nowadays.
Generally, we would consider "programming" to encapsulate the meaning of writing
a computer program nowadays. Computer programs being something that follows a
given procedure, executed on a computer.
